name: RUA - Remove Uppercase Accents
description: Remove uppercase accents for Greek characters.
project_description:
This module uses jQuery to remove accents from Greek (currently) accented characters that have been capitalized through CSS. It adds a script that runs on the document ready event and re-runs after every AJAX response. The selection is based on the effective CSS rules defining the uppercase text transformation: text-transform: uppercase; and font-variant: small-caps;. The JS script can easily be adapted to other languages. The project used to be called 'remove_upcase_accents'.
